{{Quote|You seem to have missed the order that all Stromma aboard the ''Admonitor'' were to report to the Number Three hangar deck for disembarkation.|Lieutenant Dramos Sanjin to Stormtrooper Lhagva|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
'''Number Three''' was one of the the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] decks.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> after [[Stromma Council Liaison]] removed the [[Stromma contingent|Stromma stormtrooper contingent]] from the [[Empire of the Hand]]'s service, all Stromma aboard the ''Admonitor'' were [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] to travel to Number Three for disembarkation. Stromma [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] [[Lhagva]] ignored the order, as [[Gender/Legends|he]] wanted to participate in the incoming Imperial [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|forces]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]], which led to [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Dramos Sanjin]], who reminded Lhagva of the order, allowing him not to disembark and to participate in the attack.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Number Three was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' novella, published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
